generation.mode: built-in imagegen edit with the edit target first and the canon second as reference only

lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient magnitude peak divided by uniform-bin mean after a local separable Lanczos3 reproduction at the 2560 px shipped canvas; water-mask pixels and gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: The aggregate and rock-direction proxies clear the measured threshold, but some generated rounded boulders still show visible top-to-side value separation; the strict no-lit-side rule is therefore not claimed.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median connected dark-green crown width across 24 isolated candidate components in the source raster, scaled by 2560/1254; diagnostic overlay is diagnostics/c1-3-conifer-components.png.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: manual estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: The broad luminous central meadow and open glades count as buildable; only the short fall banks, sandy gully banks, and immediate shore slope count as steep; the surrounding moor, shingle, boulders, and tree stands make up the remainder.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels; binary alpha
water_mask.derivation: Source-raster colour and luminance classification constrained only by broad coast and hydrology search envelopes, followed by connectivity growth, local closure, and enclosed-hole filling. The final boundary follows painted wet pixels; no polyline supplies it.
water_mask.component_note: One coast/sound component and one north-beck/pool/fall component; the generated sandy gully between fall and coast is visibly dry and is not mislabeled as water.
water_mask.edge_note: The east count is only the shared south-east corner pixel required by full south-edge coverage.

final_canvas_gate_reproduction.note: The installed Node executable is unavailable in this managed PowerShell environment, so the repository formula was reproduced locally at the actual 2560 px final scale.

open_risks: The generated source does not paint a continuous drowned inlet below the fall: the lower gully is dry pale sand before it reaches the sound. The mask follows the source and does not conceal this content failure.
The measured median conifer crown is about 60.223 px / 2.891 m at the final 2560 px scale, below the required 84-147 px / 4-7 m range; multiple crowns are visibly below the required floor.

Some rounded boulders retain lighter upper areas and darker lower sides. The numeric rock-lighting proxy is 0.073812 against the 0.15 limit, but the stricter equal-face-value visual rule is not established.
The official Node authoring gate was unavailable; the 6 px and 48 px checks were reproduced with the same classifier and scaling procedure at 2560 px.
Seam continuity, water-mask judgment, and overall visual quality remain director and owner decisions; this report does not claim visual acceptance.
